written.headline: Nvidia chips accessed by Chinese companies in SE Asia data centers
written.summary: Massive data centers in Southeast Asia exploited a gap in U.S. sanctions to provide computing power for Chinese companies using Nvidia AI chips. This backdoor route built a multibillion-dollar business that kept Beijing in the AI race.

written.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns following investigation into personal relationships
written.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned following an investigation into personal relationships, with CFO Colette Kress taking over as interim chief. The departure of the 33-year company veteran leaves the world's most valuable public chipmaker facing a leadership transition.

written.headline: TSMC plans $500M fund to invest in chip startups and suppliers
written.summary: TSMC plans to use a new $500 million venture fund to invest in chip startups, suppliers, and other upstream partners. Senior executive Kevin Zhang stated the company wants to support future chip titans during the AI boom.

written.headline: Nebuly raises $21M Series A to measure business value of AI agents
written.summary: Nebuly has raised a $21 million Series A funding round to expand its platform that measures the return on investment of enterprise AI agents. The Turin-based company connects to custom-built agents and assistants from providers such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Microsoft Copilot to analyze their impact on productivity and revenue.

written.headline: Democrats launch inquiry into Nvidia chip sales and Trump administration policies
written.summary: Congressional Democrats launched an inquiry into the Trump administration's handling of Nvidia chip sales to China and export licenses. The investigation follows the ouster of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang amid a scandal connecting company leadership, government officials, and foreign shipments.
